1601	children, educate, educate, educate. What will be afterwards? Let Him work, He will do
1602	His part. Everything is heading toward rectification. May HaKadosh Baruch Hu help us to truly merit to cling to the Torah,
1603	to come regularly to Torah classes from beginning to end, to get a picture, so that even if you didn't come
1604	to this world except to receive this education, it is enough for you; you can survive in all worlds, in all of life and in everything
1605	there is. Right: class after class is the greatest gift, and the more a person comes
1606	from beginning to end and sits inside, not outside, not nearby, not in nothing,
